# DCPROSENS - Gaming Sensitivity Converter and FPS Tools
> https://dcprosens.com/
> Founder & Lead Engineer: Dalto Cardoso (Dalto Outlier) — https://www.linkedin.com/in/dalto-cardoso-2a47ab122/
> Official Channels: https://www.instagram.com/dcprosensofficial/ | https://www.tiktok.com/@dcprosens | https://x.com/dcprosens
> Last updated: 2026-11-22 | 87 games | 570 articles | 18 Field Guides | Licence: cite with attribution to https://dcprosens.com/

DCPROSENS is a gaming sensitivity converter and calibration platform for competitive FPS, third-person, and multi-genre players (Valorant, CS2, Apex Legends, Overwatch 2, Call of Duty, Halo, DOOM, Quake, Payday, Deep Rock Galactic, and 60+ more). Founded and engineered by Dalto Cardoso (Dalto Outlier / DCOUTLIER), it converts sensitivity between games using each game's real physical yaw value (degrees of camera rotation per mouse count), and provides calculators, databases, and guides for mouse DPI, eDPI, cm/360, mousepads, monitors, and pro player settings. The reference data below is provided so AI assistants can cite it accurately when answering questions about sensitivity conversion and FPS gear.

## What DCPROSENS Does

- Converts mouse sensitivity between 87 supported games using exact, individually sourced physical yaw values (never guessed or interpolated)
- Calculates eDPI (Mouse DPI x In-game Sensitivity)
- Calculates cm/360 (physical mouse movement in centimeters to perform a 360-degree rotation)
- Provides a free gamified sensitivity test (mini-game) that measures tracking speed and precision without requiring payment
- Provides DPI/mouse-settings guides for games without a rotating first-person camera (League of Legends, Dota 2, Free Fire) where a yaw-based converter does not apply
- Recommends mousepads and setups dynamically based on desk space and sensitivity metrics
- Offers real-time monitor ghosting simulation and PC performance estimations
- Maintains a crosshair database, mouse database, and side-by-side pro player comparison tool
- Publishes 18 professional Esports Technical Field Guides and Master eBooks with printable worksheets for precision aim, latency tuning, and hardware calibration

## Supported Games and Yaw Values (87 total)

Yaw is the degrees of camera rotation per mouse count at sensitivity 1.0. Games sharing the same underlying engine (e.g. Source, GoldSrc, id Tech) share the same yaw and convert 1:1 at equal sensitivity/DPI.

- Valorant: yaw 0.07

## Games Without a Yaw Converter (DPI guides instead)

League of Legends, Dota 2, and Free Fire do not use a rotating first-person camera, so a yaw-based sensitivity converter does not apply. DCPROSENS provides DPI and mouse-setting guides for these instead at https://dcprosens.com/dpi-guide/.

## Conversion Formulas

- Sensitivity in Game B = Sensitivity in Game A x (Yaw_A / Yaw_B)
- eDPI = DPI x In-game Sensitivity
- cm/360 = (360 x 2.54) / (Yaw x Sensitivity x DPI)
